recipe.title: How to Cook Tofu
recipe.description: Learn how to cook tofu with these tips and tricks! Find my go-to baked tofu recipe, plus ideas for using it in stir fries, bowls, and more.
ingredients: 14 ounces extra-firm tofu (patted dry and cubed)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the cubed tofu with the olive oil, tamari, and sriracha. For extra crispy tofu, sprinkle with the cornstarch and gently toss to coat.
Spread the tofu evenly onto the baking sheet. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until browned around the edges. Remove and serve warm.
